# Bootstrap 2.3.2

The CSS and PNG files are unmodified copies from the [compiled release archive](https://getbootstrap.com/2.3.2/assets/bootstrap.zip) linked by the [official documentation](https://getbootstrap.com/2.3.2/). The demo uses the layout of the original [Basic marketing site example](https://getbootstrap.com/2.3.2/examples/hero.html).

- `css/bootstrap.min.css`, `css/bootstrap-responsive.min.css` — Bootstrap v2.3.2, copyright 2013 Twitter, Inc. [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt).
- `img/glyphicons-halflings.png`, `img/glyphicons-halflings-white.png` — [Glyphicons Free](https://www.glyphicons.com/), [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
